applicabilityBasis.summary: Solstice markets USX as an overcollateralized dollar settlement asset and payment rail. Current USX documentation restricts direct minting and redemption to KYC'd institutional partners, with USDC, USDG, or USDT deposits and USDG as the primary redemption asset. The current whitepaper identifies USX Ltd as the purpose-built token issuer; the U.S. qualification pathway and any foreign-issuer exception remain unresolved.

genius.notes: The 2026-08-14 negative-authorization review is retained as historical evidence, not a current approval finding. The current whitepaper names USX Ltd as the purpose-built token issuer, unlike the prior whitepaper's Foundation issuance description; platform Terms still name Solstice Foundation as the agreement counterparty. The issuer-field correction is proposed pending resolution of these entity-role disclosures. The institutional website claims a MiCA notification and EU/EEA access, but Terms exclude EEA and UK users. The 2026-10-01 ESMA OTHER register identifies SLX Ltd, and its registered whitepaper expressly covers the SLX token, not USX; notification is not regulatory approval. No USX/USX Ltd/Solstice Foundation entry was found in the fetched EMT or ART register. The OCC pending digital-asset table also had no such entry, but is not an exhaustive GENIUS authorization register.
